ai_summary: Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Limited reported a strong Q1 FY27, achieving double-digit growth across key financial metrics, with revenue up 11% and PAT increasing 21%, alongside a 50 bps expansion in consolidated EBITDA margin. Growth was broad-based, driven by robust retail and e-commerce channels and significant margin improvement in Emerging Brands, supported by ongoing strategic store expansion. While gross margins saw a slight contraction due to channel mix and provisioning, management asserts it is not material and anticipates offsetting future cost increases through price hikes and operational efficiencies.
